subject: Wire Bash shell-write gate into Claude plugin hooks/hooks.json
description:
The shared enforcement script hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh exists and Codex/Cursor adapter samples wire it, but the canonical Claude plugin hooks/hooks.json only gates Write|Edit — not Bash. Fresh zonoid init / plugin-only installs therefore allow shell write bypass (python -c, cp, redirects, etc.) unless users manually merge Bash into ~/.claude/settings.json.

Scope:
- Add PreToolUse matcher Bash → ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh in hooks/hooks.json
- Verify parity with adapters/codex/hooks.json.sample and adapters/cursor/hooks.json.sample (each adapter wires its shell tool name; shared logic stays in hooks/)
- Update docs if adapter-contract or CLAUDE.md implies bash gate is default-on for Claude plugin
- Smoke: unclaimed subagent + cp to repo path should exit 2 when hooks loaded
